Landing.metaDescription: Elmorf turns fragmented, inconsistent data into a structured, queryable model your software can actually use.
Landing.support: Elmorf turns fragmented, inconsistent data into a structured, queryable model your software can actually use.
Landing.whatBody: A compiler for records that do not agree with each other. Sources stay files. The compiled model is what your code queries.
Landing.loadBody: Bring in the files you already have. Elmorf does not ask you to remodel them first.
Landing.compileBody: A versioned model resolves objects, relations, and conflicts from those sources.
Landing.getBody: Ask the current model for an object, a table, or a graph, and keep the evidence.
Landing.demoBody: The Vendor Contracts example: five sources become a model, then one query.
Landing.snippet:
import elmorf

elmorf.load(project="vendor-contracts")
elmorf.compile(project="vendor-contracts")
result = elmorf.get(project="vendor-contracts", query="open invoices")
Landing.useCaseContractsBody: Keep the parties, the agreement, and the invoices attached to the same objects.
Landing.useCaseProductsBody: Turn price lists and catalogs into products that still point at the file they came from.
Landing.useCaseCrmBody: Collapse duplicate people and companies without throwing away the rows that disagreed.
Landing.useCaseEntitiesBody: Decide which records are the same object, and which only look similar.
Landing.useCaseKnowledgeBody: Give later queries one model instead of a pile of spreadsheets.
Landing.useCaseReconcileBody: See a conflict when two sources describe the same fact differently.
Landing.tryBody: Vendor Contracts is a fixed corpus on the try page: prepared sources, the compiled model, morphology, and a query. No account.
Landing.tryPageBody: Vendor Contracts is already compiled. Open an object, read its evidence, and run a query. This page does not create an account.
Landing.footerNote: Theme and language stay in this browser.
